title: Interactive Audio Director & Authoring Workbench
objective: Provide deterministic interactive-audio direction and authoring-workbench preparation over completed PCA production foundations while preserving AAI audio cue/soundscape semantics, DWC constructed-language pronunciation authority, ARI resource/provenance/rights authority and runtime owner domains, and keeping authored audio plans distinct from live playback, canonical narrative/runtime mutation or publication.

scope.purpose: Prepare local-first, provider-replaceable interactive-audio direction and authoring projections without replacing AAI, DWC, ARI, narrative/runtime or playback authorities.
scope.completion_gate: Representative authorized audio-semantic, owner and ARI inputs can deterministically prepare inspectable interactive-audio direction and authoring plans with stable provenance and fail-closed invalid owner/reference/rights/adapter states while preserving AAI/DWC/ARI/runtime authority and remaining useful with optional external audio tools disabled.

selection_boundaries: PCA-01..06 remain completed foundations and were composed rather than reimplemented or weakened.

AAI retains audio source/asset identities, cue/soundscape semantics, playback/layering/mixer behavior, event/scene bindings and GM preparation; PCA-07 produced preparation-only authoring projections and no parallel audio runtime or semantic registry.
DWC-SPEECH retains constructed-language pronunciation authority; PCA-07 bound explicit validated pronunciation references only and performed no pronunciation synthesis or mutation.

ARI-02/ARI-03/ARI-11 retain resource identity, derivative-lineage and rights/use authority; PCA-07 emitted candidate registration references only and performed no ARI registration or rights/lineage mutation.
Scene/Event/World/Combat and other runtime owners retain canonical gameplay/narrative state; PCA-07 performed no runtime owner mutation or live playback.

Optional audio-tool/provider adapters remain replaceable; PCA-07 performed no credential access, network/provider execution, paid-service operation, procurement, public upload, publication, release or canonical mutation.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after exact-tree PCA-07 publication. PCA-07 satisfies PCA-08's direct milestone but unlocks no rotation or studio start: MSAS still requires PCA-08, PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER; PCA-08 is therefore the lawful next selected item.
PCA-08 is selected_not_started only; no branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. PCA-09+, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
next_action: PCA-07 is closed. PCA-08 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
